content.text:
That's expected behavior: Tailwind scans source files as plain text and can't resolve Blade/PHP interpolation like `{{ Vite::image('hero.jpg') }}` inside `bg-[url(...)]` — it needs the complete, literal class string at build time, so the arbitrary-value class never gets generated. Your inline `style="background-image: url(...)"` workaround is correct since it bypasses class scanning entirely.

**Source:** `src/docs/detecting-classes-in-source-files.mdx`, "Dynamic class names" section (lines 65–131) — "Since Tailwind scans your source files as plain text, it has no way of understanding string concatenation or interpolation... Always use complete class names."
